summary: 44-year-old man fell about 15 ft and suffered a lower leg injury while climbing roped on Kiener's Route on Longs Peak on Saturday afternoon; his climbing partner and four nearby climbers helped him to the top of Lamb's Slide, where rangers used a tandem rappel/lowering operation to get him down to Mills Glacier; flown to Saint Anthony Hospital
location: Kiener's Route, Longs Peak, Rocky Mountain National Park
notes: Incident date pinned to Sat 2011-08-13: report filed Tue Aug 16 says the cell call came "on Saturday afternoon"; weekday-verified.
wx_note: ERA5 archive 0.25° grid (Open-Meteo); coord basis: peak (Longs Peak)
